description: Los Angeles International Airport - Passenger Count By Carrier Type is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Passenger Statistic By Carrier Type. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are lax, airport, carrier, flight, passenger. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Airports. The portal shows 2023-11-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
